# optimizelycmp_workflow (Data Source)

Looks up one workflow by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workflow name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the workflow.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_asset_approval_enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_flexible` (Boolean)
- `is_resource_management_enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_smart_duration_enabled` (Boolean)
- `step_names` (List of String)
